defects: Gold compares the rank of a single fixed module N under two different scalar actions (as an S-module vs. as an R-module via IsScalarTower/restriction of scalars); produced instead compares the rank of M (over R) to the rank of a different module M ⊗[R] FractionRing R (over FractionRing R) — an extension-of-scalars statement, not a restriction-of-scalars statement for one module in a tower.

Deriving the produced statement from the gold requires an additional non-trivial fact not present in gold: that rank_R(M) equals rank_R(M ⊗ FractionRing R) (i.e. rank is unaffected by localizing/extending scalars), so the two are not directly interchangeable.

Gold is stated in full generality for any IsLocalization p S with p ≤ R⁰ and any f : M →ₗ[R] N with IsLocalizedModule p f; produced hardcodes p = R⁰ and S = FractionRing R (and the canonical tensor-product map), losing this generality.
Produced requires IsDomain R and uses M ⊗[R] FractionRing R directly rather than the abstract IsFractionRing R S / general N formulation used by gold.
Produced weakens M's typeclass to AddCommMonoid instead of AddCommGroup as used for M/N in gold.
